scope.description: Read-only component review of LongLineage runtime, HTSlib reader, topology and artifact-writing code for existing accelerations, bottlenecks, semantic risks and bounded lossless improvements. No source modification is authorized.

assumptions: Current implementation may be incomplete and must not be described as production-ready.
A code-path observation is not a measured performance claim.

step_verify.step: Map implemented and planned accelerations to exact code and contract paths.
step_verify.verify: Handoff lists each item with status, path, semantic invariant and missing verification.

step_verify.step: Identify no more than five high-value lossless implementation candidates.
step_verify.verify: Each candidate includes risk, expected metric and a test capable of rejecting semantic drift.
